1	/**
2	 * Rate limiters — Upstash Ratelimit.
3	 *
4	 * Falls back to a permissive no-op limiter when UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL /
5	 * UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN are absent (local dev without Redis).
6	 *
7	 * Production MUST have both env vars set or all limiters will always allow
8	 * requests — the startup check in lib/env.ts will warn in that case.
9	 */
10	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
11	
12	// ─── Limiter interface (matches Upstash RatelimitResponse shape) ────────────
13	export interface RateLimitResponse {
14	  success: boolean
15	  limit: number
16	  remaining: number
17	  reset: number
18	}
19	
20	export interface Limiter {
21	  limit: (identifier: string) => Promise<RateLimitResponse>
22	}
23	
24	// ─── No-op fallback (used when Redis env vars absent) ───────────────────────
25	function makeNoop(name: string): Limiter {
26	  let warned = false
27	  return {
28	    async limit() {
29	      if (!warned) {
30	        logger.warn(
31	          { limiter: name },
32	          'rate-limit: UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL not set — limiter is permissive (dev mode)',
33	        )
34	        warned = true
35	      }
36	      return { success: true, limit: 9999, remaining: 9999, reset: Date.now() + 60_000 }
37	    },
38	  }
39	}
40	
41	// ─── Real Upstash limiter factory ────────────────────────────────────────────
42	function makeUpstashLimiter(
43	  requests: number,
44	  windowSeconds: number,
45	  name: string,
46	): Limiter {
47	  const url = process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL
48	  const token = process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN
49	
50	  if (!url || !token) {
51	    return makeNoop(name)
52	  }
53	
54	  // Sliding window via Upstash REST API — no Node.js SDK dependency needed.
55	  // Uses the MULTI/EXEC pattern: INCR + EXPIRE in one round-trip.
56	  return {
57	    async limit(identifier: string): Promise<RateLimitResponse> {
58	      const key = `rl:${name}:${identifier}`
59	      const now = Date.now()
60	      const windowMs = windowSeconds * 1_000
61	
62	      try {
63	        // Pipeline: INCR key + EXPIRE key windowSeconds
64	        const pipelineRes = await fetch(`${url}/pipeline`, {
65	          method: 'POST',
66	          headers: {
67	            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
68	            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
69	          },
70	          body: JSON.stringify([
71	            ['INCR', key],
72	            ['EXPIRE', key, windowSeconds],
73	          ]),
74	        })
75	
76	        if (!pipelineRes.ok) {
77	          logger.warn({ name, status: pipelineRes.status }, 'rate-limit: Upstash pipeline error — allowing request')
78	          return { success: true, limit: requests, remaining: requests, reset: now + windowMs }
79	        }
80	
81	        const results = await pipelineRes.json() as [{ result: number }, { result: number }]
82	        const count = results[0].result
83	
84	        const remaining = Math.max(0, requests - count)
85	        const reset = now + windowMs
86	
87	        if (count > requests) {
88	          return { success: false, limit: requests, remaining: 0, reset }
89	        }
90	
91	        return { success: true, limit: requests, remaining, reset }
92	      } catch (err) {
93	        // On Redis error: fail open (allow) and log
94	        logger.error({ err, name }, 'rate-limit: Redis error — failing open')
95	        return { success: true, limit: requests, remaining: requests, reset: now + windowMs }
96	      }
97	    },
98	  }
99	}

1	/**
2	 * Stripe webhook event processor — extracted helper.
3	 *
4	 * Called by:
5	 *   1. app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts — after signature verification
6	 *   2. workers/jobs/webhook-replay.ts   — bypasses sig verification for trusted internal replays
7	 *
8	 * This function is the ONLY source of truth for post-verification Stripe event dispatch.
9	 * Adding a new event type: add a case here only, not in the route.
10	 *
11	 * INVARIANT 7: Dodo (L1) and Stripe (L2) abstractions never share a module.
12	 *
13	 * Design note — no `import type Stripe from 'stripe'`:
14	 * Workers use moduleResolution: Node which resolves stripe to the CJS default export
15	 * (StripeConstructor) where Stripe.Account / Stripe.Event are not accessible. App uses
16	 * moduleResolution: bundler which resolves the ESM default export where they are.
17	 * Solution: structural local interfaces for the shapes we actually need. The Stripe SDK
18	 * types are a superset of these interfaces — both callers satisfy them at runtime.
19	 */
20	
21	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
22	import {
23	  RPC,
24	  type StripeConnectedAccountUpdateFromWebhookArgs,
25	  type StripeChargeUpdateStatusFromWebhookArgs,
26	  type StripeDisputeRecordArgs,
27	  type StripeDisputeUpdateStatusFromWebhookArgs,
28	  type ConnectedAccountOnboardingStatus,
29	  type Currency,
30	  type StripeChargeStatus,
31	  type StripeDisputeStatus,
32	  cents,
33	} from '@/lib/payments/contracts'
34	
35	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
36	// Local structural interfaces — describe exactly the fields this module uses.
37	// The Stripe SDK types are structural supersets of these.
38	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
39	
40	interface StripeAccountShape {
41	  id: string
42	  charges_enabled?: boolean | null
43	  payouts_enabled?: boolean | null
44	  capabilities?: Record<string, string> | null
45	  requirements?: {
46	    disabled_reason?: string | null
47	    current_deadline?: number | null
48	    errors?: unknown[]
49	  } | null
50	  country?: string | null
51	  default_currency?: string | null
52	}
53	
54	interface StripePaymentIntentShape {
55	  id: string
56	  latest_charge?: string | { id: string } | null
57	  metadata?: Record<string, string | undefined> | null
58	  amount?: number                                     // S17
59	  currency?: string | null                            // S17
60	  amount_details?: {                                  // S17
61	    tax?: { amount: number } | null
62	    tax_breakdown?: Array<{
63	      amount: number
64	      jurisdiction?: { country?: string; state?: string | null } | null
65	      tax_rate_details?: { tax_type?: string | null } | null
66	    }> | null
67	  } | null
68	}
69	
70	interface StripeChargeShape {
71	  id: string
72	  payment_intent?: string | null
73	  amount: number
74	  amount_refunded: number
75	  currency?: string | null
76	  status?: string | null
77	}
78	
79	interface StripeDisputeShape {
80	  id: string
81	  charge?: string | { id?: string } | null
82	  evidence_details?: { due_by?: number | null } | null
83	  reason?: string | null
84	  status?: string | null
85	  amount: number
86	  currency?: string | null
87	}

89	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
90	// Untyped RPC helpers — Sprint 13: RPCs not yet in generated types.ts.
91	// Run `pnpm db:types` after Dato's migration lands to remove these casts (§S13.3).
92	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
93	
94	type UntypedRpc = (
95	  fn: string,
96	  args: Record<string, unknown>,
97	) => Promise<{ data: unknown; error: { message: string } | null }>
98	
99	type UntypedFrom = (table: string) => {
100	  select: (cols: string) => {
101	    eq: (col: string, val: string) => {
102	      maybeSingle: () => Promise<{ data: Record<string, string> | null; error: unknown }>
103	    }
104	  }
105	}
106	
107	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
108	// Public interfaces — exported so worker and route handler can use them
109	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
110	
111	/**
112	 * Minimal structural event interface for the processStripeEvent public signature.
113	 *
114	 * Stripe.Event satisfies this structurally. Workers cast `rawPayload as StripeEventLike`.
115	 * Using a structural type avoids the Stripe.Event import incompatibility between
116	 * moduleResolution: bundler (app) and moduleResolution: Node (workers).
117	 */
118	export interface StripeEventLike {
119	  id: string
120	  type: string
121	  data: { object: unknown }
122	}
123	
124	/**
125	 * Minimal Supabase client interface — only the operations this module uses.
126	 * Structural (not nominal) so both @supabase/ssr and @supabase/supabase-js clients satisfy it.
127	 * Both expose `rpc` and `from` as functions with a `.bind` method (Function prototype).
128	 */
129	export interface SupabaseServiceClient {
130	  rpc: { bind(thisArg: unknown): (...args: never[]) => unknown }
131	  from: { bind(thisArg: unknown): (...args: never[]) => unknown }
132	}
133	
134	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
135	// Main dispatch function
136	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
137	
138	/**
139	 * Dispatch a verified Stripe event to the appropriate handler.
140	 *
141	 * @param event   - Verified Stripe event (signature already checked by caller).
142	 * @param supabase - Service-role client. Bypasses RLS. Caller must supply this.
143	 * @throws         - On RPC failure. Caller is responsible for error logging + retry.
144	 */
145	export async function processStripeEvent(
146	  event: StripeEventLike,
147	  supabase: SupabaseServiceClient,
148	): Promise<void> {
149	  logger.info({ type: event.type, eventId: event.id }, 'stripe: processing event')
150	
151	  switch (event.type) {
152	    case 'account.updated':
153	      await handleAccountUpdated(event.data.object as StripeAccountShape, supabase)
154	      break
155	
156	    case 'payment_intent.succeeded':
157	      await handlePaymentIntentStatusChange(
158	        event.data.object as StripePaymentIntentShape,
159	        'succeeded',
160	        event.type,
161	        supabase,
162	      )
163	      break
164	
165	    case 'payment_intent.payment_failed':
166	      await handlePaymentIntentStatusChange(
167	        event.data.object as StripePaymentIntentShape,
168	        'requires_payment_method',
169	        event.type,
170	        supabase,
171	      )
172	      break
173	
174	    case 'payment_intent.canceled':
175	      await handlePaymentIntentStatusChange(
176	        event.data.object as StripePaymentIntentShape,
177	        'canceled',
178	        event.type,
179	        supabase,
180	      )
181	      break
182	
183	    case 'charge.refunded': {
184	      await handleChargeRefunded(event.data.object as StripeChargeShape, supabase)
185	      break
186	    }
187	
188	    case 'charge.dispute.created':
189	      await handleDisputeCreated(event.data.object as StripeDisputeShape, supabase)
190	      break
191	
192	    case 'charge.dispute.closed':
193	      await handleDisputeClosed(event.data.object as StripeDisputeShape, supabase)
194	      break
195	
196	    case 'invoice.finalized': {
197	      await handleInvoiceFinalized(event.data.object as StripeInvoiceShape, supabase)
198	      break
199	    }
200	    case 'invoice.payment_succeeded': {
201	      await handleInvoicePaymentSucceeded(event.data.object as StripeInvoiceShape, supabase)
202	      break
203	    }
204	
205	    default:
206	      logger.info({ type: event.type, eventId: event.id }, 'stripe: event recorded, not processed')
207	  }
208	}
209	
210	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
211	// account.updated
212	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
213	
214	async function handleAccountUpdated(
215	  account: StripeAccountShape,
216	  supabase: SupabaseServiceClient,
217	): Promise<void> {
218	  const onboardingStatus = deriveOnboardingStatus(account)
219	  const capabilities = account.capabilities ?? {}
220	  const restrictedReason = account.requirements?.disabled_reason ?? null
221	
222	  const currentDeadline = account.requirements?.current_deadline
223	  const requirementsDueBy = currentDeadline
224	    ? new Date(currentDeadline * 1_000).toISOString()
225	    : null
226	
227	  const args: StripeConnectedAccountUpdateFromWebhookArgs = {
228	    accountId: account.id,
229	    onboardingStatus,
230	    capabilities: {
231	      charges_enabled: account.charges_enabled ?? false,
232	      payouts_enabled: account.payouts_enabled ?? false,
233	      transfers: capabilities['transfers'] === 'active',
234	      tax_reporting_us_1099_nec: capabilities['tax_reporting_us_1099_nec'] === 'active',
235	    },
236	    country: account.country ?? 'US',
237	    defaultCurrency: (account.default_currency ?? 'usd') as Currency,
238	    restrictedReason,
239	    requirementsDueBy,
240	  }
241	
242	  const rpc = supabase.rpc.bind(supabase) as unknown as UntypedRpc
243	  const { data, error } = await rpc(RPC.STRIPE_CONNECTED_ACCOUNT_UPDATE_FROM_WEBHOOK, {
244	    p_account_id: args.accountId,
245	    p_onboarding_status: args.onboardingStatus,
246	    p_capabilities: args.capabilities,
247	    p_country: args.country,
248	    p_default_currency: args.defaultCurrency,
249	    p_restricted_reason: args.restrictedReason,
250	    p_requirements_due_by: args.requirementsDueBy,
251	  })
252	
253	  if (error) {
254	    logger.error({ err: error, accountId: account.id }, 'stripe: account.updated RPC failed')
255	    throw error
256	  }
257	
258	  logger.info({ accountId: account.id, result: data }, 'stripe: account.updated processed')
259	}
260	
261	function deriveOnboardingStatus(account: StripeAccountShape): ConnectedAccountOnboardingStatus {
262	  if (account.charges_enabled && account.payouts_enabled) return 'active'
263	
264	  const disabledReason = account.requirements?.disabled_reason
265	  if (disabledReason) return 'restricted'
266	
267	  const errors = account.requirements?.errors ?? []
268	  if (errors.length > 0) return 'restricted'
269	
270	  return 'pending'
271	}
272	
273	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
274	// payment_intent.succeeded / payment_failed / canceled
275	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
276	
277	async function handlePaymentIntentStatusChange(
278	  pi: StripePaymentIntentShape,
279	  status: StripeChargeStatus,
280	  eventType: string,
281	  supabase: SupabaseServiceClient,
282	): Promise<void> {
283	  const latestCharge = pi.latest_charge
284	  const chargeId =
285	    typeof latestCharge === 'string'
286	      ? latestCharge
287	      : ((latestCharge as { id?: string } | null)?.id ?? null)
288	
289	  const args: StripeChargeUpdateStatusFromWebhookArgs = {
290	    paymentIntentId: pi.id,
291	    status,
292	    chargeId: chargeId ?? null,
293	    transferId: null,
294	    applicationFeeId: null,
295	  }
296	
297	  const rpc = supabase.rpc.bind(supabase) as unknown as UntypedRpc
298	  const { data, error } = await rpc(RPC.STRIPE_CHARGE_UPDATE_STATUS_FROM_WEBHOOK, {
299	    p_payment_intent_id: args.paymentIntentId,
300	    p_status: args.status,
301	    p_charge_id: args.chargeId,
302	    p_transfer_id: args.transferId,
303	    p_application_fee_id: args.applicationFeeId,
304	  })
305	
306	  if (error) {
307	    logger.error({ err: error, piId: pi.id, status }, 'stripe: charge status update RPC failed')
308	    throw error
309	  }
310	
311	  logger.info({ piId: pi.id, status, result: data }, 'stripe: payment_intent status updated')
312	
313	  const depositTxnId = pi.metadata?.inkos_deposit_transaction_id
314	
315	  if (eventType === 'payment_intent.succeeded') {
316	    // SAGA step 2 — confirm deposit
317	    if (depositTxnId && depositTxnId.length > 0) {
318	      const { error: confirmErr } = await rpc(RPC.CONFIRM_DEPOSIT_APPLICATION, {
319	        p_transaction_id: depositTxnId,
320	        p_payment_intent_id: pi.id,
321	      })
322	      if (confirmErr) {
323	        logger.error({ pi_id: pi.id, deposit_txn: depositTxnId, err: confirmErr },
324	          'CRITICAL: confirm_deposit_application failed on PI succeeded')
325	        throw confirmErr
326	      }
327	    }
328	
329	    // Write commission_splits row from PI metadata
330	    const studioId = pi.metadata?.inkos_studio_id
331	    const artistId = pi.metadata?.inkos_artist_id
332	    const bookingId = pi.metadata?.inkos_booking_id
333	    const sessionId = pi.metadata?.inkos_session_id
334	    if (studioId && artistId && bookingId) {
335	      // §S13.3 — types.ts regen pending; cast for stripe_charges read
336	      const fromUntyped = supabase.from as unknown as (table: string) => {
337	        select: (cols: string) => {
338	          eq: (col: string, val: string) => {
339	            single: () => Promise<{ data: Record<string, unknown> | null; error: unknown }>
340	          }
341	        }
342	      }
343	      const { data: chargeData } = await fromUntyped('stripe_charges')
344	        .select('net_artist_cents, application_fee_cents, tip_amount_cents, deposit_drawdown_cents, transfer_id')
345	        .eq('payment_intent_id', pi.id)
346	        .single()
347	
348	      if (chargeData) {
349	        const charge = chargeData as {
350	          net_artist_cents: number
351	          application_fee_cents: number
352	          tip_amount_cents: number
353	          deposit_drawdown_cents: number
354	          transfer_id: string | null
355	        }
356	        const totalArtistShare = charge.net_artist_cents + charge.application_fee_cents
357	        const commissionPct = totalArtistShare > 0
358	          ? Math.round((charge.net_artist_cents / totalArtistShare) * 100)
359	          : 100
360	
361	        const { error: splitErr } = await rpc(RPC.COMMISSION_SPLIT_RECORD, {
362	          p_studio_id: studioId,
363	          p_booking_id: bookingId,
364	          p_session_id: sessionId ?? null,
365	          p_artist_id: artistId,
366	          p_base_amount_cents: charge.net_artist_cents,
367	          p_commission_pct: commissionPct,
368	          p_tip_amount_cents: charge.tip_amount_cents,
369	          p_applied_from_pool_cents: charge.deposit_drawdown_cents,
370	          p_stripe_transfer_id: charge.transfer_id,
371	          p_kind: 'split',
372	        })
373	        if (splitErr) {
374	          logger.error({ pi_id: pi.id, err: splitErr },
375	            'commission_split_record failed on PI succeeded — recoverable via reconciliation cron')
376	          // Don't throw — reconciliation cron will catch this
377	        }
378	      }
379	    }
380	
381	    // === S17 — Tax mirror + per-tax-line attribution ===
382	
383	    const taxTotal = pi.amount_details?.tax?.amount ?? 0
384	    const taxBreakdown = pi.amount_details?.tax_breakdown ?? []
385	
386	    // 1. Update stripe_charges.tax_amount_cents via charge update RPC.
387	    // Track D extended stripe_charge_update_status_from_webhook to accept p_tax_amount_cents.
388	    const { error: chargeTaxErr } = await rpc(RPC.STRIPE_CHARGE_UPDATE_STATUS_FROM_WEBHOOK, {
389	      p_payment_intent_id: pi.id,
390	      p_status: 'succeeded',
391	      p_charge_id: typeof pi.latest_charge === 'string'
392	        ? pi.latest_charge
393	        : (pi.latest_charge?.id ?? null),
394	      p_transfer_id: null,
395	      p_application_fee_id: null,
396	      p_tax_amount_cents: taxTotal,
397	    })
398	    if (chargeTaxErr) {
399	      logger.error({ pi_id: pi.id, err: chargeTaxErr },
400	        'S17: stripe_charge_update_status_from_webhook (tax pass) failed')
401	      throw chargeTaxErr
402	    }
403	
404	    // 2. Per-tax-line attribution to commission_splits.
405	    if (taxBreakdown.length > 0 && studioId && bookingId) {
406	      // §S13.3 — types.ts regen pending
407	      const fromUntyped2 = supabase.from.bind(supabase) as unknown as (table: string) => {
408	        select: (cols: string) => {
409	          eq: (col: string, val: string) => {
410	            eq: (col2: string, val2: string) => {
411	              order: (col3: string, opts: { ascending: boolean }) => {
412	                limit: (n: number) => {
413	                  maybeSingle: () => Promise<{ data: { id: string } | null; error: unknown }>
414	                }
415	              }
416	            }
417	          }
418	        }
419	      }
420	      const { data: parentSplitData } = await fromUntyped2('commission_splits')
421	        .select('id')
422	        .eq('booking_id', bookingId)
423	        .eq('kind', 'split')
424	        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
425	        .limit(1)
426	        .maybeSingle()
427	
428	      if (parentSplitData) {
429	        const parentSplitId = parentSplitData.id
430	        const eventDate = new Date()
431	        const quarter = Math.floor(eventDate.getMonth() / 3) + 1
432	        const period = `${eventDate.getFullYear()}-Q${quarter}`
433	
434	        // Look up studio's primary location once.
435	        const fromUntypedSelect = supabase.from.bind(supabase) as unknown as (table: string) => {
436	          select: (cols: string) => {
437	            eq: (col: string, val: string) => {
438	              limit: (n: number) => {
439	                maybeSingle: () => Promise<{ data: { id: string } | null; error: unknown }>
440	              }
441	            }
442	          }
443	        }
444	        const { data: locationData } = await fromUntypedSelect('locations')
445	          .select('id')
446	          .eq('studio_id', studioId)
447	          .limit(1)
448	          .maybeSingle()
449	
450	        for (const line of taxBreakdown) {
451	          const country = line.jurisdiction?.country ?? null
452	          const state = line.jurisdiction?.state ?? null
453	          const jurisdiction = state ? `${country ?? 'US'}-${state}` : (country ?? 'UNKNOWN')
454	          const taxLineId = `${parentSplitId}:${jurisdiction}`
455	
456	          const { error: lineErr } = await rpc(RPC.COMMISSION_SPLIT_TAX_LINE_RECORD, {
457	            p_parent_split_id: parentSplitId,
458	            p_tax_line_id: taxLineId,
459	            p_jurisdiction: jurisdiction,
460	            p_tax_amount_cents: line.amount,
461	          })
462	          if (lineErr) {
463	            logger.error({ pi_id: pi.id, parent_split: parentSplitId, jurisdiction, err: lineErr },
464	              'S17: commission_split_tax_line_record failed — recoverable via reconciliation')
465	          }
466	
467	          if (locationData) {
468	            const { error: accrueErr } = await rpc(RPC.TAX_REMITTANCE_ACCRUE, {
469	              p_studio_id: studioId,

471	              p_jurisdiction: jurisdiction,
472	              p_period: period,

478	            }

482	        logger.warn({ pi_id: pi.id, booking_id: bookingId },
483	          'S17: parent commission_split not found — tax breakdown not recorded')
484	      }

487	      const fallbackJurisdiction = 'UNKNOWN'
488	      const eventDate = new Date()
489	      const quarter = Math.floor(eventDate.getMonth() / 3) + 1
490	      const period = `${eventDate.getFullYear()}-Q${quarter}`
491	
492	      const fromUntypedSelect2 = supabase.from.bind(supabase) as unknown as (table: string) => {
493	        select: (cols: string) => {
494	          eq: (col: string, val: string) => {
495	            limit: (n: number) => {
496	              maybeSingle: () => Promise<{ data: { id: string } | null; error: unknown }>
497	            }
498	          }
499	        }

502	        .select('id')

504	        .limit(1)
505	        .maybeSingle()

507	      if (locationData) {

509	          p_studio_id: studioId,
510	          p_location_id: locationData.id,
511	          p_jurisdiction: fallbackJurisdiction,
512	          p_period: period,

517	            'S17: tax_remittance_accrue (UNKNOWN fallback) failed — recoverable via reconciliation')

521	          'S17: tax mirror UNKNOWN fallback — studio has no locations row, tax accrual skipped')
522	      }

526	    }
527	  }

529	  if (eventType === 'payment_intent.payment_failed' || eventType === 'payment_intent.canceled') {

539	          'CRITICAL: rollback_deposit_application failed on PI failed/canceled')

541	      }
542	    }

1	/**
2	 * InkOS Payments — RPC + DB row contracts (Sprint 13)
3	 *
4	 * Source of truth for the dual-stack payment system.
5	 *   • L1 — Dodo Payments (SaaS subscriptions, MoR-handled global tax). Existing.
6	 *   • L2 — Stripe Connect Express (in-studio marketplace, NEW from Sprint 13).
7	 *
8	 * EVERY RPC SIGNATURE LIVES HERE BEFORE DATO WRITES THE MIGRATION.
9	 * Param-name drift between TS and SQL is the #1 InkOS bug source (per inkos-lessons §1).
10	 *
11	 * Money is ALWAYS stored as `cents INT`. Never numeric. Never float.
12	 * Banker's rounding when splitting.
13	 *
14	 * Owner: inkos-payments-lead (.claude/agents/inkos-payments-lead.md)
15	 */
16	
17	// =====================================================================
18	// PRIMITIVE TYPES
19	// =====================================================================
20	
21	/** ISO 4217 lowercase currency code as used by Stripe. Lock the supported set. */
22	export type Currency = 'usd' | 'gbp' | 'eur' | 'aud' | 'cad';
23	
24	/**
25	 * Money expressed as integer minor units (cents, pence, etc).
26	 * Branded so a raw `number` can't be passed where money is expected.
27	 */
28	export type CentsAmount = number & { readonly __brand: 'CentsAmount' };
29	
30	/** Construct a CentsAmount with bounds checking. Negative amounts allowed for refunds/reversals. */
31	export function cents(value: number): CentsAmount {
32	  if (!Number.isInteger(value)) {
33	    throw new Error(`CentsAmount must be integer, got ${value}`);
34	  }
35	  return value as CentsAmount;
36	}
37	
38	/**
39	 * Idempotency key carried in Stripe metadata for webhook reconciliation.
40	 * UUID v4 generated at call site; same key reused on retry of same logical operation.
41	 */
42	export type InkosIdempotencyKey = string & { readonly __brand: 'InkosIdempotencyKey' };
43	
44	/** Webhook event source — used in `webhook_events.source` UNIQUE constraint. */
45	export type WebhookSource = 'dodo' | 'stripe';
46	
47	// =====================================================================
48	// ENUMS — mirror SQL CHECK constraints
49	// =====================================================================
50	
51	/** Stripe Connect Express account type. One per studio (mandatory) + optional one per artist. */
52	export type ConnectedAccountType = 'studio' | 'artist';
53	
54	/** Connect onboarding lifecycle. Updated by `account.updated` webhook. */
55	export type ConnectedAccountOnboardingStatus =
56	  | 'pending'    // account created, KYC not started
57	  | 'active'     // charges_enabled && payouts_enabled
58	  | 'restricted' // partially complete; some capabilities disabled
59	  | 'rejected';  // permanently blocked by Stripe
60	
61	/** Stripe charge lifecycle (mirrored from PaymentIntent status). */
62	export type StripeChargeStatus =
63	  | 'requires_payment_method'
64	  | 'requires_confirmation'
65	  | 'requires_action'
66	  | 'processing'
67	  | 'requires_capture'
68	  | 'canceled'
69	  | 'succeeded'
70	  | 'refunded'
71	  | 'partially_refunded';
72	
73	/** Dispute lifecycle. */
74	export type StripeDisputeStatus =
75	  | 'warning_needs_response'
76	  | 'warning_under_review'
77	  | 'warning_closed'
78	  | 'needs_response'
79	  | 'under_review'
80	  | 'won'
81	  | 'lost'
82	  | 'charge_refunded';
83	
84	/** Defense pack assembly + submission status. */
85	export type DisputeDefensePackStatus =
86	  | 'pending'    // BullMQ job not yet run
87	  | 'assembling' // job running, gathering documents
88	  | 'ready'      // bundle PDF generated, awaiting submission
89	  | 'submitted'  // sent to Stripe via /v1/disputes/:id
90	  | 'failed';    // assembly or submission errored
91	
92	/** Commission split kind — distinguishes original split from reversal. */
93	export type CommissionSplitKind =
94	  | 'split'      // original 70/30 split on session settlement
95	  | 'reversal'   // reverses a prior split (refund, dispute lost)
96	  | 'adjustment' // manual correction (rare, audit-logged)
97	  | 'tip';       // tip-only transfer (separate row from base split)
98	
99	/** Tax remittance ledger row status. */
100	export type TaxRemittanceStatus =
101	  | 'open'           // collected this period, not yet remitted
102	  | 'manual_review'  // Stripe Tax API failed or jurisdiction not supported
103	  | 'filed'          // remittance filed with tax authority
104	  | 'paid';          // payment cleared

106	/** 1099-NEC export source — Stripe-issued vs InkOS-internal calc. */

111	// =====================================================================
112	
113	/**
114	 * `webhook_events` — first write of every webhook handler.
115	 * UNIQUE (source, event_id) drives idempotency.
116	 * `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (source, event_id) DO NOTHING` returns 200 immediately on replay.
117	 */

119	  id: string;                     // UUID

192	  id: string;
193	  studio_id: string;
194	  dispute_id: string;                         // dp_xxx
195	  charge_id: string;                          // ch_xxx (FK to stripe_charges.charge_id)

211	 * Reconciles to Stripe Tax reports within $0.01.

229	 * `commission_splits` — one row per artist payout per session settlement.
230	 * Reversals reference parent_split_id for refund/dispute proportional clawback.

232	export interface CommissionSplitRow {
233	  id: string;
234	  studio_id: string;
235	  booking_id: string | null;
236	  session_id: string | null;
237	  artist_id: string;
238	  base_amount_cents: CentsAmount;             // pre-fee artist share

247	  tax_line_id: string | null;                 // Stripe tax_line_xxx (null when single-line or no Stripe Tax)
248	  jurisdiction: string | null;                // e.g. 'US-NY-NYC', 'GB', 'EU-DE' — for ledger remittance

252	/**
253	 * `dispute_defense_packs` — bundled evidence PDF + provenance trail.
254	 */
255	export interface DisputeDefensePackRow {
256	  id: string;
257	  dispute_id: string;
258	  signed_consent_url: string | null;
